notes.title: Looking for Beta Testers + Giveaway
notes.content:
We are currently adding more passives and bosses, so we need testers to try the beta and give us feedback. Participating in the beta and giving us feedback will increase your chance at receiving a steam key for the full version. 

If you are interested to be a Beta Tester and want to enter the giveaway, then please fill the following form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSewIPGTKLRhzrWdKAUWKtgodvl54JBBYfYB-Or61agh0tHH7Q/viewform



Thanks everyone. We are looking forward to the beta phase.
